rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Harm: a projected slide with a referent nobody named. Closest: chunk 1 L7 'that something is the team's guesses' (antecedent 'something tells the team which build is worth making' is the preceding sentence); chunk 3 L29 'His three rules' resolves to Rob Fitzpatrick named in L27. 'this training' L9 is the room's own training.

Harm: positional callback to another file. Closest: chunk 2 L20 'Those snapshots' points inside the same slide at the one-page snapshot; no 'the opening lecture' style pointers in L1-33 of the expanded view.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no 'the X you did/saw/caught' backward references in any chunk

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no live-demo or guess-before-reveal beat; all three chunks are verbed prose

rules_evaluated.evidence: Closest: chunk 3 L27-31, three paragraphs, each carrying a claim; every chunk has a self-carrying header claim plus body.

Closest: chunk 2 L13 'Great research can still miss the outcome' over L16 'great at research and still don't meet their outcomes'; header and body say the same thing. Chunk 1 L4 and chunk 3 L24 likewise match their bodies.

Closest: chunk 3 L31 'not fluff, opinions or compliments' is a concrete list inside one declarative, not a 'Not X. Not Y. Z.' run; chunk 1 L7 chain of four short clauses carries new content each leg. No self-grading superlatives, no number+retraction, no abstraction stacks, no empty verb triplet.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Closest: chunk 3 L27 'fluff' is Fitzpatrick's own quoted term, not repo dialect. Banned-word/dialect greps in view: banned_words, ritual_ceremony, session_biography all CLEAN (0). Accept-notes: none in maintainer block.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: grep -c '\*\*' on expanded body L1-33 -> 0 bold. Italics only for the book title (L27).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Presence precedes content — verify against the composed deck, not long-read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Three slides arrive via standalone include links (L3,5,7) resolved by expand-md; all three appear in the expanded body L1-33. Module include at whats-actually-true.md:34 puts the lecture in the module deck. Not a prework or reference phase-less section.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Slide size — 210 words / 6 bullets, and the cap is machine-checked.
Heading grammar is the mood switch, and it is load-bearing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Lecture headings L4, L13, L24 are all claims ('What customers did beats what they say they will do' is the closest to a label-free declarative and is a claim); none is a bare label.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A bullet earns its slot or dies — three classes that read as rigour and carry nothing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Closest: chunk 1 L9 'It is still where to start.' restates 'should start there' in the same paragraph (class c shape), but the preceding 'That sells less of this training.' concedes a cost and the pair closes the slide's one advice; judged below the cut threshold, offered as a suggestion. Chunk 2 L20 and chunk 3 L31 each add a move (snapshot feeds agents; agent sorts, team decides).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A retitled slide re-earns its bullets against the new header.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Rename b758b28b changed L13 header from 'Talk to customers every week, toward an outcome' to 'Great research can still miss the outcome'; body L16 opens on the new header's claim (research without outcome), L18-20 resolve it with the weekly practice. No inherited bullet answers only the old header. Chunk 1 and 3 headers were added with their bodies (e9cbe889, 4f50a398).
